                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          B ని అమర్చిన తర్వాత మిగిలిన స్థానం మిగిలిన వ్యక్తి అయిన D చే ఆక్రమించబడుతుంది.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          కాబట్టి, చివరి అమరిక ప్రకారం, D A కు ఎడమవైపున రెండవ స్థానంలో ఉంది.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          కాబట్టి, \"రెండవ  ఐచ్ఛికం \" సరైన సమాధానం.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n12c:T819,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दिलेल्याप्रमाणे: सहा मित्र, A, B, C, D, E आणि F एका वर्तुळाकार टेबलाभोवती केंद्राकडे तोंड करून बसले आहेत.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1) F हा C च्या उजवीकडे दुसरा आणि A च्या डावीकडे तिसरा आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2) C हा A आणि E चा लगत शेजारी आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          दिलेल्याप्रमाणे: सहा मित्र, A, B, C, D, E आणि F एका वर्तुळाकार टेबलाभोवती केंद्राकडे तोंड करून बसले आहेत.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1) F हा C च्या उजवीकडे दुसरा आणि A च्या डावीकडे तिसरा आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2) C हा A आणि E चा लगत शेजारी आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3) B हा C च्या डावीकडे दुसरा आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          প্রদত্ত: ছয়জন বন্ধু, A, B, C, D, E এবং F একটি বৃত্তাকার টেবিলে কেন্দ্রের দিকে মুখ করে বসে আছে।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1) F, C-র ডান দিকে দ্বিতীয় এবং A-র বাম দিকে তৃতীয়।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2) C, A এবং E-র ঠিক নিকটবর্তী।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3) B, C-র বাম দিকে দ্বিতীয়।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          B-কে স্থাপন করার পর শুধুমাত্র একটি স্থান বাকি থাকে যা শুধুমাত্র বাকি ব্যক্তি D দ্বারা দখল করা হবে।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          সুতরাং, চূড়ান্ত বিন্যাস অনুসারে, D A-র বাম দিকে দ্বিতীয়।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          অতএব, \"বিকল্প 2\" সঠিক উত্তর।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n12e:T74a,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          આપેલ છે: છ મિત્રો, A, B, C, D, E, અને F એક ગોળ ટેબલની આસપાસ કેન્દ્ર તરફ મુખ કરીને બેઠા છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1) F એ C ની જમણી બાજુએ બીજો અને A ની ડાબી બાજુએ ત્રીજો છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2) C એ A અને E નો નજીકનો પાડોશી છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          આપેલ છે: છ મિત્રો, A, B, C, D, E, અને F એક ગોળ ટેબલની આસપાસ કેન્દ્ર તરફ મુખ કરીને બેઠા છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1) F એ C ની જમણી બાજુએ બીજો અને A ની ડાબી બાજુએ ત્રીજો છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2) C એ A અને E નો નજીકનો પાડોશી છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3) B એ C ની ડાબી બાજુએ બીજો છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          B ને ગોઠવ્યા પછી માત્ર એક જ સ્થાન બાકી રહે છે જે બાકી રહેલા વ્યક્તિ એટલે કે D દ્વારા રોકવામાં આવશે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          આમ, અંતિમ ગોઠવણી મુજબ, D એ A ની ડાબી બાજુએ બીજો છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          તેથી, \"વિકલ્પ 2\" સાચો જવાબ છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n12f:T77b,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1) F ಯು C ಯ ಬಲಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡನೆಯವನು ಮತ್ತು A ಯ ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ ಮೂರನೆಯವನು.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2) C ಯು A ಮತ್ತು E ಯ ತಕ್ಷ", "kn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ: ಆರು ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರು, A, B, C, D, E, ಮತ್ತು F ಒಂದು ವೃತ್ತಾಕಾರದ ಮೇಜಿನ ಸುತ್ತಲೂ ಕೇಂದ್ರದ ಕಡೆಗೆ ಮುಖ ಮಾಡಿ ಕುಳಿತಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          1) F ಯು C ಯ ಬಲಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡನೆಯವನು ಮತ್ತು A ಯ ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ ಮೂರನೆಯವನು.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2) C ಯು A ಮತ್ತು E ಯ ತಕ್ಷಣದ ನೆರೆಯವನು.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3) B ಯು C ಯ ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡನೆಯವನು.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          B ಯನ್ನು ಇರಿಸಿದ ನಂತರ ಒಬ್ಬ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಉಳಿದಿದೆ ಅಂದರೆ D.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ಹೀಗಾಗಿ, ಅಂತಿಮ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ, D ಯು A ಯ ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ ಎರಡನೆಯವನು.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ, \"ಆಯ್ಕೆ 2\" ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರವಾಗಿದೆ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n130:T851,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          கொடுக்கப்பட்டது: ஆறு நண்பர்கள், A, B, C, D, E, மற்றும் F ஒரு வட்ட மேசையைச் சுற்றி மையத்தை நோக்கி அமர்ந்துள்ளனர்.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2) C என்பவர் A மற்றும் E க்கு உடனடி அண்டை வீட்டார்", "ta": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          2) C ହେଉଛି A ଏବଂ E ର ନିକଟତମ ପଡୋଶୀ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          3) B ହେଉଛି C ର ବାମକୁ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          B କୁ ସ୍ଥାନିତ କରିବା ପରେ କେବଳ ଗୋଟିଏ ସ୍ଥାନ ବାକି ଅଛି ଯାହା କେବଳ ବାକି ଥିବା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଅର୍ଥାତ୍ D ଦ୍ୱାରା ଅଧିକୃତ ହେବ।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is Allahabad.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Jawaharlal Nehru, the first Prime Minister of independent India, was born on 14 November 1889 in Allahabad.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Allahabad, now known as Prayagraj, is a city in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • He was born into a wealthy and politically active family, with his father Motilal Nehru being a prominent lawyer and nationalist leader.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Jawaharlal Nehru played a pivotal role in India's struggle for independence and was a central figure in Indian politics both before and after independence.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Jawaharlal Nehru\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Jawaharlal Nehru was an Indian independence activist and, subsequently, the first Prime Minister of India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • He emerged as a prominent leader of the Indian independence movement under the tutelage of Mahatma Gandhi.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Nehru's vision of India was rooted in secularism, socialism, and democracy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • He is also remembered for his efforts in establishing institutes of higher learning, such as the Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) and the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Allahabad (Prayagraj)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Allahabad, officially known as Prayagraj, is a historic city in the state of Uttar Pradesh in India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • It is one of the oldest cities in India, with a history dating back to ancient times.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • The city is known for its confluence of three rivers – the Ganges, the Yamuna, and the mythical Saraswati – a site called Triveni Sangam.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Prayagraj is also famous for the Kumbh Mela, a mass Hindu pilgrimage held every 12 years.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Motilal Nehru\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Motilal Nehru was an Indian lawyer, activist, and politician who was a leader of the Indian National Congress.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • He was a prominent figure in the Indian independence movement and the father of Jawaharlal Nehru.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Motilal Nehru was an advocate of constitutional reforms and played a key role in the drafting of the Nehru Report, which outlined a proposed constitutional framework for India.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
